title: Book Two · Chapter 41: Under the Drawer
story:
On Saturday, Dad brings the brown box home again.

“Mr Sun agreed,” he tells Mum. “I can check it here this weekend. It goes back on Monday.”

Mum clears one end of the table. Her blue skirt is on the bed. She moves it into her own cloth bag, away from Dad's work.

Ronan brings the old work cloth. Dad spreads it under the box. The brass handle has a small dark mark near one end. Dad leaves that mark alone.

He pulls the drawer out slowly. It catches near the back.

“Still there,” Ronan says.

“The front moves better now,” Dad says. “But this part still rubs.”

Dad lifts the drawer. He turns it over on the cloth. A thin wooden board runs across the bottom. He puts a straight strip of wood against it.

There is a small gap in the middle.

“It isn't flat,” Ronan says.

“No. And this edge is damp.”

Dad shows him the darker wood. Ronan looks but keeps his hands on his knees.

“Is that your old piece?”

“Yes. I put this piece in at the old shop.”

Dad checks the other side. He makes one small pencil mark. Then he puts the straight strip down.

“Will you cut it smaller?” Ronan asks.

“I need another check first. I don't want to take too much off.”

Dad puts the drawer on a dry board. The box stays beside it. Ronan leans closer, but Dad moves a sharp tool back into the blue toolbox.

“You can pass me the small cloth,” he says.

Ronan finds it beside Dad's cap. He holds it out by one corner.

“The clean part?”

“Yes. Thank you.”

Dad wipes a little dust from the side. The old pencil marks show more clearly now.

Ronan looks from those marks to the new one.

“Can you tell the old marks from the new mark?”

“Most of them. I made them differently.”

He points to one old line. “I was trying to finish quickly then.”

Ronan waits for more. Dad does not tell the whole story. He looks closely at the wood again.

Mum comes back from the front room. She needs to fold a customer's coat. Dad moves the box to the low work board and clears the table for her.

Ronan takes his school book to the bed. Monday is two days away. Miss Wu will talk to him about his own answers then.

He reads a few lines in an old story. His kite page is still with Miss Wu. He closes the book again. He does not know the result yet.

Dad sits by the work board. He keeps the drawer flat and checks the gap again.

“Can we have lunch first?” Ronan asks.

Dad looks at the window. “Yes. My eyes need a rest, too.”

Mum brings two bowls from the kitchen. Ronan gets another. Dad washes his hands at the yard tap.

The box stays on its cloth. Nobody puts a bowl on it. Mum looks at Dad's dusty sleeve.

“Not on my new skirt,” she says.

Dad holds both arms well away from her. Ronan laughs and makes a little more room at the table.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

drawer＝抽屉；damp＝潮湿的；flat＝平的；handle＝拉手。

## 理解问题

1. Dad这次在抽屉底部发现了什么？
2. 木盒什么时候必须送回Mr Sun处？

## 读句子

**Dad / lifts / the drawer.** 爸爸／抬起／抽屉。
